title: rgb - Angels (feat. 4-Tress & Kid April)
htmlContent:
rgb featuring 4-Tress & Kid April's "Angels" is an amazing body work that makes you an instant fan of their artistry. They shine bright like the true star that they are, as they make a feel good smash that you want to keep on replay. It delivers in all its magic to make a masterpiece that you want to be apart of for every second they gives us.
